description: Person B: a young man of about 25 with short curly black hair and a short dark beard, medium-brown skin, wearing an oversized plain white T-shirt. Location B: a dim modern kitchen at night lit by violet-blue LED strip light on the walls and ceiling, dark cabinets behind him. He sits behind a light oak table; on the table in front of him, centred, one ordinary clear stemless glass. Static frontal camera at table height; calm, deadpan, slightly amused.
